summary: Written by the data agent at build time, pending a real judge. Six shows make the top 10: Squid Game (three seasons), Wednesday and Stranger Things (two each), Adolescence, Dahmer and Bridgerton. Typing a show names its best season; later seasons are named by number.
reasons: Casual found 7 (Stranger Things, Squid Game, Wednesday, Bridgerton, Dahmer, Squid Game 2, Adolescence) and ran out of lives on The Crown, Money Heist, The Witcher, Ozark and Emily in Paris.

Those misses show no figure: Netflix publishes only its all-time top 10, so every other season has none. The title says the measure (views in the first 91 days) and the prompt says a series can appear more than once.
Not Blitz-ready: only the 10 answers have a figure. Films (KPop Demon Hunters, Red Notice) are a separate table and free here.
